title: FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves: Terry and Mai classic costumes go on sale 22 Oct (330 yen each in Japan)

sources.note: SNK's image: DLC costumes Terry Bogard, Mai Shiranui from 22 Oct, 330 yen each tax incl.; platforms Switch 2, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Steam, Epic
Switch 2: Mai's classic costume from 22 Oct needs the digital pre-order; physical early-purchase bonus and paid DLC from 21 Jan 2027 or later; both costumes were purchase and pre-order bonuses

notes: 18 Oct: first dropped at 05:20Z over Mai's revealing outfit in SNK's screens; rebuilt at 05:45Z for the 07:30Z gap with Terry's half of the screens only and Mai shoulders-up in the announcement art. Built b149 (stills, spectacle). Grammar review: no required edits; S1, S2, U1 to U4 taken. Gate 05:51Z Exit A. Queued 07:30Z under the rolling queue.
18 Oct 07:39Z: PUBLISHED on X, Instagram, Threads at 07:30Z (postsListTool).
